drivers.notes: Turnip 26.2.0 R8 standard Android package from the AdrenoTools registry, selected for Adreno 830. Pending validation on Adreno 830; upstream release notes list A6xx/A7xx only. Native Vulkan startup must still validate driver loading and DMA-BUF capabilities.

Android half of the bundle. Adreno 840 tested on SM-F976B/Android 17. Native Vulkan startup must still validate driver loading and DMA-BUF capabilities. GPU variants require their own explicit mapping.
